highlight.title: GitHub Actions 2026 Security Roadmap: The Biggest CI/CD Overhaul in History
highlight.summary: GitHub just announced the most comprehensive security update in Actions history, introducing immutable dependency tracking, centralized execution controls, and real-time telemetry streaming. After Q1 2026's supply chain attacks hit 23,000+ repositories through mutable action references, GitHub's response targets root causes with secure-by-default primitives rather than band-aid fixes.

resources.title: Anthropic's Claude Code CLI: Terminal-First AI Agent for Developers
resources.why_now: Claude Code represents the terminal's evolution from command-line interface to AI workspace, offering autonomous file editing and project understanding that outpaces traditional IDE extensions. The February 2026 general availability makes it the first production-ready AI agent designed specifically for CLI workflows.

resources.title: VS Code January 2026: Multi-Agent Development Becomes Native
resources.why_now: Microsoft positioned VS Code as the 'home for multi-agent development' with native agent session management, background delegation, and browser-driving agents. This isn't just AI autocomplete—it's orchestrating multiple specialized agents across local, cloud, and background execution contexts.

resources.title: Google Antigravity 2.0: CLI-First Platform with Agent Orchestration
resources.why_now: Google's May I/O 2026 pivot from IDE-centric to agent-orchestration represents a fundamental shift in developer tooling philosophy. The CLI-first approach with scheduled background agents moves beyond single-turn assistance toward persistent automation pipelines.

resources.title: Runner Scale Set Client: Custom Autoscaling Outside Kubernetes
resources.why_now: GitHub's new open-source client enables custom autoscaling solutions beyond Actions Runner Controller, addressing enterprise needs for infrastructure-specific runner management. This fills a critical gap for organizations running CI/CD on non-Kubernetes platforms while maintaining GitHub's native scaling APIs.

claude_take: The developer tooling landscape is undergoing its biggest architectural shift since the move from desktop IDEs to web-based editors—AI agents are becoming first-class citizens in our development environments. While 2025 was about AI-powered autocomplete, 2026 is about autonomous task execution, multi-agent orchestration, and CLI tools that understand entire project contexts rather than just individual files.
